objective: Prepare for Listening form completion through answer-type prediction, spellings, plurals, decimals and units.
theory: This is coach-created written preparation, NOT an audio Listening assessment. Predict names/numbers/dates/places from field labels. Preserve decimals and units: 100 cm = 1 m; 100 pence = £1. Follow the word limit and check plurals. These 20 written items cannot prove listening comprehension.
strategy: Label → predict answer type → record information → check spelling, decimal, unit, plural and word limit.

worked_example.prompt: A written note gives width one metre and twenty-five centimetres. Write decimal metres with the unit.

guided.prompt: A written note gives height one metre and sixty centimetres. Write decimal metres with the unit.
guided.hint: Convert 60 cm then add one metre. Include m.

independent.prompt: Write eighty-five centimetres as a decimal in metres. Include the unit.
Write forty centimetres as a decimal in metres. Include the unit.
Write one point eight metres in centimetres. Include the unit.
Write two and a half kilograms using digits. Include the unit.
Write thirty-six pounds and fifty pence using digits and the pound symbol.
Write one thousand two hundred pounds using digits and the pound symbol.
A made-up surname is spelled R-O-W-A-N. Write it.
A made-up street name is spelled B-R-I-D-G-E-W-O-O-D. Write it.
A fictional postcode is spelled L-S-two; space; seven-Q-R. Write it with letters and digits.
A booking code is spelled J-eight-L-zero-P. Write it without spaces.
The box contains three ___ (book). Write only the missing word.
The centre offers two ___ (class). Write only the missing word.
Visitors can learn about local ___ (custom). Write only the missing word.
The clubs provide several ___ (activity). Write only the missing word.
Correct the spelling of the word for communication through words: langauge.
Correct the spelling of a building for borrowing books: libary.
Field Family name: ___. Predict type: surname / date / price.
Field Room capacity: ___ people. Predict type: number / street name / material.
Field Arrival date: ___. Predict type: weight / date / surname.
NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS. Information desk is inside the central library. Complete Information desk location: ___ using the building name only.

q18.explanation: Capacity in people needs a number.

q20.explanation: The building name is two words.

coach_only.rubric: Assess only the displayed/submitted scope. Separate grammar, spelling, punctuation and fulfilment. Coach-created support practice; no IELTS band, CEFR or mastery claim. Preserve initial responses and post-feedback revisions.
